facts.fact: TEMPLARS says L.I. 2523, in force 9 June 2026, requires banks, insurers, telecoms operators, hospitals and government agencies that verify identity with the Ghana Card to confirm it biometrically against the card chip or the National Identity Register, with a transition window to 2 November 2026.
